d: S1:E13 The Barrys - David and Mary are desperate to move closer to their grandchildren, but after 18 months on the market and a staggering £90,000 price cut, their East Boldon family home of 30 years has only been viewed once.

S1:E14 The Kinchleas - With a three-hour commute to Dad's new job (and to the family's temporary crash pad in the neighbourhood), the Kinchleas are desperate to sell their three-bedroom, Victorian mid-terrace home in Bow, East London…

S1:E15 The Lotts - Tired of his long daily commute, Gary wants to sell his riverside property next to London's Limehouse Basin and move closer to work… But after six months, only four viewings, and not a single offer, his home is languishing on the market.

S1:E16 The Williams - Dennis and Sue are desperate to sell their two-bedroom Thamesmead home so they can permanently reunite in the country… But, after a year on the market, few viewings, four agents, and two major price cuts, Sue's already moved to Norfolk while Dennis is stuck in their unsellable home.
S1:E3 Carri-Ann | Eileen - A former beauty queen can't quite commit to the wedding dress and a Kim Kardashian look alike bride finds a dress fit for an Armenian princess.
S1:E4 Lorielle | Regina - A ‘B' horror movie actress and her posse grace Renee's star looking to have some fun, and a brother helps his younger sister find her dream wedding gown.

S1:E5 Rachel | Sara - A former ‘Big Brother' reality show star shops for her dress before the wedding date's been set ,and an Emmy award winning producer gets choked up dress shopping with her dad who's recently been diagnosed with Alzheimers.

S2:E7 Conifers and Pelargoniums - In tonight's show CAROL KLEIN flies the flag for conifers. On her revival she visits the Pinetum at RHS Garden Wisley, to learn how we first became obsessed with conifers.
S2:E8 Lilies and Woodland Gardens - In tonight's show JAMES WONG is convinced we should all be growing lilies in our gardens.

S1:E1 Coming To Canada - Tori and Dean are in Canada's cottage country where they have just two days to find a fixer-upper they can turn into the perfect summer getaway. Two weeks later, they barely survive the California-to-Canada family road trip. But the real adventure begins with demolition day.
S4:E8 Matchmaker Mark - Mark's friends are constantly looking to him for advice, so when "Big A" lands a date he turns to Mark.
